narrative: Material PL2__M8766F2A exhibits a regular, near-normally distributed demand pattern averaging 111,894 units per working day with no detectable trend across 241 observations. Lead times are highly unstable (CV=0.90), ranging from near-zero to over 6 days, with transport variability as the dominant driver. A continuous-review (r,Q) policy with EOQ-based order quantity and a statistically derived safety stock of 280,293 units is recommended to achieve the 95% service level target. The SAP safety lead time of 5.0 days should be reduced to 2.29 days to reflect actual observed lead time behaviour.
warnings: Annual total cost increases by $398,878 vs current policy — this reflects the explicit cost of achieving 95% service level vs current zero-safety-stock policy.

research_insights.selection_rationale: Regular demand with near-Normal distribution and high-volume daily throughput is ideally suited to a continuous-review (r,Q) model. The EOQ provides the cost-optimal order quantity and the reorder point is calibrated to the 95% service level using the combined demand-lead-time variance formula.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Storage capacity of 1,369,437 units is not binding: safety_stock + order_quantity = 332,971, well within limit. No capacity-driven reduction applied.
